name: Blue Eyes, primite
sourceNote: Deck list matched to the supplied screenshot and cross-checked against the matching 40-card/15-card Blue-Eyes Primite list in the Yu-Gi-Oh! card database.
extraDeck: Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres

combos.name: Ether Beryl + Sage — Core Full Combo
combos.result: Two Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon lines into Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon + Crimson Dragon → Stardust Sifr Divine Dragon, with True Light/Wishes/Primite follow-up depending on hand.
combos.verifiedThrough: Step 11 is based on the published Primite Blue-Eyes combo sequence; later branches will be expanded in the app as we test them against your exact Master Duel deck.

steps.title: Normal Summon Ether Beryl
steps.action: Normal Summon Primite Dragon Ether Beryl.
steps.why: Ether Beryl is one of the deck's main starters.

steps.title: Set Primite Lordly Lode
steps.action: Activate Ether Beryl's on-summon effect and Set Primite Lordly Lode from the Deck.
steps.why: Lordly Lode turns the Primite starter into access to Drillbeam and a Normal Monster summon.

steps.title: Add Primite Drillbeam
steps.action: Activate Primite Lordly Lode and add Primite Drillbeam.
steps.why: Drillbeam becomes a searchable interaction piece.

steps.title: Link Summon Spirit with Eyes of Blue
steps.action: Use Ether Beryl to Link Summon Spirit with Eyes of Blue.
steps.why: Spirit is the bridge from Ether Beryl into the Eyes of Blue engine.

steps.title: Search Mausoleum of White
steps.action: Use Spirit with Eyes of Blue's Link Summon effect to add Mausoleum of White from the Deck.
steps.why: Mausoleum provides the additional Normal Summon needed for the Level 1 LIGHT Tuner line.

steps.title: Activate Mausoleum
steps.action: Activate Mausoleum of White.
steps.why: This gives you an additional Normal Summon for a Level 1 LIGHT Tuner.

steps.title: Normal Summon Sage
steps.action: Use Mausoleum's additional Normal Summon to Normal Summon Sage with Eyes of Blue.
steps.why: Sage is the key Level 1 LIGHT Tuner and searches another Level 1 LIGHT Tuner.

steps.title: Search Maiden of White
steps.action: Activate Sage and add Maiden of White from the Deck.
steps.why: Maiden is the tuner that places True Light and can return when Blue-Eyes is Special Summoned.

steps.title: Place True Light
steps.action: Send Maiden of White from your hand/field to the GY to place True Light face-up from the Deck.
steps.why: True Light gives you another Blue-Eyes summon and access to Blue-Eyes Spell/Trap setup.

steps.title: Send Blue-Eyes to the GY
steps.action: Use Mausoleum's monster-targeting effect to send Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the Deck to the GY.
steps.why: You need Blue-Eyes in the GY for the Spirit with Eyes of Blue summon line.

steps.title: Special Summon Blue-Eyes
steps.action: Tribute Spirit with Eyes of Blue to Special Summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the GY.
steps.why: Spirit converts the Link-1 into a Blue-Eyes body and triggers the Maiden line.

steps.title: Bring back Maiden
steps.action: When Blue-Eyes White Dragon is Special Summoned, use Maiden of White in the GY to Special Summon itself.
steps.why: This gives you the second Level 1 LIGHT Tuner needed for the double Spirit Dragon sequence.

steps.title: Make the first Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon
steps.action: Use Sage with Eyes of Blue + a Blue-Eyes non-Tuner to Synchro Summon Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon.
steps.why: Spirit Dragon is the first Synchro step and can later tag into a Level 12 LIGHT Dragon Synchro.

steps.title: Create the second Blue-Eyes body
steps.action: Use the remaining Blue-Eyes/Level 1 LIGHT Tuner resources and the True Light/Wishes line available from your hand to establish the second Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon route.
steps.why: The full line needs two Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragons so each can be converted into a higher Synchro boss.

steps.title: Spirit Dragon → Ultimate Spirit Dragon
steps.action: Tribute a Synchro Summoned Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon to Special Summon Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon from the Extra Deck.
steps.why: Ultimate Spirit Dragon provides the field-effect negate for the endboard.

steps.title: Spirit Dragon → Crimson Dragon
steps.action: Tribute the other Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon to Special Summon Crimson Dragon in Defense Position.
steps.why: Crimson Dragon is the bridge into the Level 12 Synchro boss line.

steps.title: Crimson Dragon adds Synchro Rumble
steps.action: When Crimson Dragon is Special Summoned, add Synchro Rumble from the Deck to your hand.
steps.why: Synchro Rumble provides recovery and supports the next Synchro line.

steps.title: Crimson Dragon → Stardust Sifr Divine Dragon
steps.action: Use Crimson Dragon's Quick Effect to return itself to the Extra Deck and Special Summon Stardust Sifr Divine Dragon with the same Level as the targeted Level 12 Synchro.
steps.why: Sifr adds a monster-effect negate and destruction protection to the board.

steps.title: Check Primite interaction
steps.action: Keep Primite Drillbeam available and use it when its activation condition is met to negate and banish a face-up card.
steps.why: This adds another layer of interaction without needing to spend the main boss monsters.

steps.title: Endboard check
steps.action: Confirm your final monsters, True Light/Wishes setup, Drillbeam, and available follow-up before passing the turn.
steps.why: The goal is not only the biggest board; preserve the resources that let Blue-Eyes continue next turn.

combos.name: Wishes for Eyes of Blue — Starter Line
combos.result: Searches a Level 1 LIGHT Tuner plus a Blue-Eyes Spell/Trap and begins the Eyes of Blue line.

steps.title: Activate Wishes for Eyes of Blue
steps.action: Discard 1 card and activate Wishes for Eyes of Blue.
steps.why: Wishes is a direct 2-card search for the tuner plus Blue-Eyes Spell/Trap you need.

steps.title: Search the Level 1 LIGHT Tuner
steps.action: Add the Level 1 LIGHT Tuner needed for your hand state, commonly Sage with Eyes of Blue or Maiden of White.
steps.why: The correct tuner depends on what you already opened.

steps.title: Search the Blue-Eyes Spell/Trap
steps.action: Add the Blue-Eyes Spell/Trap that completes your line, commonly Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons or True Light.
steps.why: This second search supplies the Blue-Eyes body/setup piece.

steps.title: Continue from the selected tuner
steps.action: Choose the Sage line if you need a search/Blue-Eyes summon, or the Maiden → True Light line if that better matches your hand.
steps.why: Wishes is flexible, so the correct next step depends on the rest of the opening hand.

combos.name: Ether Beryl — 1-card Primite Line
combos.result: Primite Lordly Lode + Primite Drillbeam and access to a Normal Monster/Blue-Eyes line.

steps.title: Normal Summon Ether Beryl
steps.action: Normal Summon Primite Dragon Ether Beryl.
steps.why: Start the Primite engine.

steps.title: Set Lordly Lode
steps.action: Set Primite Lordly Lode from the Deck with Ether Beryl.
steps.why: Lode is the engine's searchable extender.

steps.title: Add Drillbeam
steps.action: Activate Lordly Lode and add Primite Drillbeam.
steps.why: You now have a searchable negate/banish interaction.

steps.title: Choose your extension
steps.action: If you also have a Blue-Eyes tuner line, convert Ether Beryl into Spirit with Eyes of Blue and continue. Otherwise preserve the Primite interaction and use Lode according to the board state.
steps.why: Ether Beryl alone does not force the same endboard as the two-card starter.
